spans.text: He MIHRING DIKNA CHANVO THUPUANCHHUAH (UNIVERSAL DELCARATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS) hi khawvela mi hnam tin leh chi tinte tan hmasawnna chhinchhiah tlâk a ni a, hei hian mitinte chu he Thupuanchhuah vawng reng chunga mimal dikna leh chanvote chawisân leh zirtîrna kawngah mawh min phurhtîr vek a, member ramte chuan an ram chhung leh ram dangte nena an inkarah leh an awp ram hrang hrangah pawh mi zawng zawng huap he mihring dikna leh chanvo chawisân leh inzah sak a, a taka hlenchhuahna kawngah mawh an phur vek a ni.

spans.text: Mi tumah hi ram khua leh tui a nihna apâwng ataka hlihsak ngawt theih an ni ramdang mi leh sa nih an duh pawhin an kawng pawh dal sak ngawt theih a ni chuang lo.

folded.id: nih hma|chuan|misual anga ngaih nghal ngawt tur a ni lova
folded.subject: nih hma
folded.object: misual anga ngaih nghal ngawt tur a ni lova

spans.text: Mi tupawh sual lian tham khawiha puh an nihin an thil tih sual chu finfiah a nih hma chuan misual anga ngaih nghal ngawt tur a ni lova, a insawi fiah theihna hun remchang siam sak ngei chu a chanvo a ni.

folded.id: nun reng|hi|thil pawimawh tak a nih avang te
folded.subject: nun reng
folded.object: thil pawimawh tak a nih avang te

spans.text: Ram hrang hrang leh hnam hrang hrangte inkara inunauna tha tak vawn nun reng hi thil pawimawh tak a nih avang te,

folded.id: ram chhungah|chuan|zalên taka chêttlat leh inbenbel theihna hi a chanvo a ni
folded.subject: ram chhungah
folded.object: zalên taka chêttlat leh inbenbel theihna hi a chanvo a ni

spans.text: Mi tu pawhin mahni ram chhungah chuan zalên taka chêttlat leh inbenbel theihna hi a chanvo a ni.

folded.id: si loh|chuan|chu a thil tihsual avang ngawt chuan a chungah hremna lian tham lekkawh ngawt tur a ni lo
folded.subject: si loh
folded.object: chu a thil tihsual avang ngawt chuan a chungah hremna lian tham lekkawh ngawt tur a ni lo

spans.text: Miin thilsual a tihin chu a thilsual tih chu a thilsual tih laia ram danpuiin hremna tham tlinga a lo puang tawh a nih si loh chuan chu a thil tihsual avang ngawt chuan a chungah hremna lian tham lekkawh ngawt tur a ni lo.

folded.id: theihna emaw|hi|an dikna leh chanvo a ni bawk
folded.subject: theihna emaw
folded.object: an dikna leh chanvo a ni bawk

spans.text: Mitinte hian an ram chhuahsan theihna emaw an rama kir leh theihna emaw hi an dikna leh chanvo a ni bawk.
Mitinte hian sa himna atana raltlân theihna emaw inhumhimna zawn emaw hi an chanvo a ni.

folded.id: thlamuanna te|hi|kan chanvo a ni
folded.subject: thlamuanna te
folded.object: kan chanvo a ni

spans.text: Mitinte hian nung turin dikna kan nei vek a, zalênna leh mimal nun thlamuanna te hi kan chanvo a ni.
